description: Assess an email address for signup or payout fraud with fixed rules: mail server, disposable domain, look-alikes of major providers, domain age, privacy-focused provider (e.g. Proton), forwarding or hidden alias (e.g. Apple Hide My Email), random-looking address, and missing SPF/DMARC on a company domain. Returns low, medium or high risk with each signal explained. Costs $0.02.
name: check_email
title: Email risk check
